name: slots
schema: CREATE TABLE slots(id integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, obj_guid text(32) NOT NULL, name text(4096) NOT NULL, slot_type integer NOT NULL, int64_val bigint, string_val text(4096), double_val float8, timespec_val text(19), guid_val text(32), numeric_val_num bigint, numeric_val_denom bigint, gdate_val text(8))
